note: The SOLIT2 Annex 7 test tunnel: the geometry of the test gallery where the SOLIT2 full-scale tests were run. This is the standard, not a project. Annex 7 5.2.6 puts the fire target 5 m downstream of the mock-up, of the same width, height and combustibility. Annex 7 5.2.7 mandates that BOTH 1.5 m/s and 3.0 m/s longitudinal velocity be tested, measured 45 m upstream of the fire -- a velocity range is a property of the TEST, not of the tunnel, so it is not carried here: see examples/designs/solit2-test-protocol.json, which sets ventilation.velocity_range_ms to [1.5, 3.0] so the envelope actually runs both. These are TEST conditions, not site conditions; Annex 7 3.3 governs transferring results between them.
